notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for the official IEEE 1516.1 timestamped regional interaction no-overlap and retraction surface. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, dimensional FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, and logical-time implementation. It verifies that a timestamped region-qualified send remains retractable when its source region does not overlap the receiver subscription, that legal pre-delivery retraction terminalizes, that an expired handle rejects retraction after producer progress, and that no filtered interaction callback is delivered without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador timestamped regional interaction and retraction with non-overlapping region filtering, time advancement, and FederateAmbassador receive and time-advance-grant callbacks
